description: Check whether a service is available at a Singapore postal code, before looking for times. Coverage depends on which of our people or partners work near the address.

service.description: Required: the code of the service the customer asked for, from find_services (e.g. cleaning, aircon, sofa_cleaning). cleaning = home cleaning by the hour, general housekeeping only: a deep clean, a spring clean, a move-out clean or one item cleaned is its own service. Every other service is booked by the job: give job_type and unit_count from its card.

name: check_area
title: Check whether HomeMaster covers an address
